observation.body:
Legacy identity: `FOS-000015`. Original source: [immutable historical definition](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/73f891d6c0cf498ac92e804d7d0f0cd344a083f5/local-docs/reviews/observability-sweep.md).

Shared requirements and grouping: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/8. All original criteria below remain required. Source status statements below describe their historical revision; current delivery evidence is recorded separately. Original relative links are resolved below.

## Original definition (verbatim)

15. **FOS-000015 — Report cancellation and bound orderly shutdown reporting.** **M; depends on `FOS-000004`, `FOS-000009`, `FOS-000013`, `FOS-000014`; §3–§4.** Linux SIGINT/SIGTERM and sentinel closure call `shutdown_processes()` ([Linux:896](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/cli/fossilize_replay_linux.hpp#L896), [Linux:1335](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/cli/fossilize_replay_linux.hpp#L1335)); expected kills suppress crash treatment but do not establish completed work. Retain cancellation origin, unfinished scope and preserved outputs; preserve platform CLI termination conventions. From healthy control flow attempt the final result with bounded cleanup. Avoid adding allocation/locking/stdio serialization to fatal signal handlers: reuse minimal preallocated evidence and let the controller report. **Check:** user cancellation, parent/sentinel loss, forced kill during cleanup, blocked result channel. A missing final result is unknown, not successful. No final-report guarantee after SIGKILL.

   **Required automated success criteria — pending implementation:**

   - **Platform subprocess tests:** Controlled SIGINT/SIGTERM or the documented Windows cancellation equivalent, sentinel closure and forced cleanup termination preserve cancellation origin, completed/persisted work and unfinished scope. The CLI obeys the documented platform termination mapping; expected child kills are not classified as spontaneous crashes.
   - **Bounded-cleanup tests:** Block result delivery/cleanup through a test adapter and assert termination within the specified cleanup budget plus test tolerance. Kill before final publication and require the consumer to report incomplete/unknown; after publication, retain only facts already authoritative. No test assumes a final record after SIGKILL.
